description: The families a pptx template's output uses (§3): the theme's fonts and the typefaces its master and layouts name. Brand Display resolves through the font resolver; Brand Sans, which the template embeds, isn't reported in pptx output; Calibri has a bundled stand-in. Source Serif 4 (the master's body style) and the layout's East Asian Brand Gothic resolve nowhere, and Broken Font's pinned bytes aren't a font, so each is `font_unresolved`, once.
